data.description:
**GYM CLASS is the top VR basketball & sports game 🏀🏈⚾** 

Experience NBA licensed team courts, full-court multiplayer games, massive worlds, simulation physics, and football & baseball stadiums. Rated best on Quest - make friends or level-up to be the best among millions in the top VR sports community.

{8704248146300574}

**Download GC FREE to experience:** 
- ➕ Unparalleled Simulation Physics: The most realistic physics in gaming. Control your shots, passes, dribble moves, and dunks like never before.
- 🎮 Multiplayer Games: Play half, fullcourt, and minigames with friends or AI.
- 🌍 Social Worlds: Connect with friends in massive environments.
- 🏈⚾ Multi-Sport: Basketball, football, baseball, arcade, & more.
- 🎨 Endless Styles: Complete Quests to unlock cosmetics - hoodies, shirts, jerseys, suits, glasses, hats, mascot costumes, green sounds, & more.
- 🏆 Level-up & Stats: Track deep stats (shots, assists, rebounds)

{2315442282123322}

**Buy the NBA Bundle to get:**
- 😮 NBA team courts: Hoop on virtual replicas of all 30 NBA team courts with friends or AI.
- 🏆 NBA team branded apparel & challenges: Two different sets of team-branded apparel, a team-branded basketball, and team-branded hat. Play games to unlock further items.
- 👕 NBA Bundle premium items: Additional NBA & team-branded shirts, hoodies, basketballs & accessories is available to purchase separately.

{969686844967912}

**GC PRO unlocks:**
- 🏠 Private Courts: Customize your world, set your rules. Play with friends privately on a wide set of GC environments.
- 👕 Full-body Avatars: Design your player w/ max control. Hairstyles, face details, facial hair, body shapes, height, tattoos, and more.
- 🎨 Cosmetics: Unlock a wide variety of cosmetics from hoodies, glasses, headphones, & gorilla around w/ banana hats.
- 🤖 Design Your Bot: Name, design, and level-up your bot. 

{557813239965509}
